label: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE (Fixture Co): a plan only. No data has been collected; every result field is empty.
intervention: The lead facilitator coaches a new trainer through three runs of the accessible publishing session for client editors
intended_performance: Client editors publish posts whose alt text and link text score 2 or 3 on the rubric; the new trainer runs the session without the lead stepping in
human_data_boundary: Fixture Co's training lead collects published posts from the client's CMS only with the client's written approval and notice to editors. Two human reviewers rate them without knowing which period each post came from. The agent drafts instruments and stops there: it records no ratings, survey results, observations or gains.
revisit_if: Median rubric score on published posts doesn't rise by at least one level after two coaching cycles; then rerun edu-needs-analysis before changing the session

measures.description: Rubric scores on up to 10 published posts per editor
measures.timing: 4 weeks before and 4 weeks after the session

measures.description: End-of-session task: fix alt text and link text in two new drafts, scored with the rubric
measures.baseline: The same task format on one draft at the session start

measures.description: The lead observes the new trainer's second run with the focus list in the facilitation guide
Two-question reaction survey, reported apart from learning evidence
